_comment: One holder per chat app, checked against the provider rather than against our own config. configure-hermes.py (install_jobs) copies moe-channel-holder.py into $HERMES_HOME/scripts/ and registers this spec through cron.jobs.create_job(**spec), keyed on its name. The work is in moe-home/connectors/channel-holder.py; this is the tick. Keys mirror create_job()'s parameters.
_why: On 2026-09-14 the owner's cloud machine was paired, `channels.py migrate` gave the edge their Telegram bot, and this Mac's gateway kept polling it — Telegram permits a webhook OR getUpdates and never both. Telegram refused the poll with a 409 and the fork's adapter recovered by calling deleteWebhook, deleting the EDGE's webhook. The machine they pay for could then never receive a message, moe_auth.channel_bindings stayed empty, and both halves reported themselves connected because each read its own config. The holder is now decided at migration and at gateway start, but neither of those can see what a running adapter does afterwards. This is the only thing that can.
_schedule: Every 15 minutes. The cost is one getWebhookInfo per channel the cloud carries — usually one HTTPS call, nothing when the cloud carries no chat app at all, and the job only ticks while Memoe.app is open. The window it bounds is 'how long a bot can be pointed away before Alfie puts it back', and fifteen minutes of missed messages while the Mac is asleep is the most this should ever cost. Faster buys little: a provider only moves when something else moved it, and the two things that do (a gateway start, a migration) run this directly. Slower is a working machine nobody can reach for an hour.
_deliver: moe — but only when Alfie has GIVEN UP. channel-holder.py repairs at most three times per channel and never twice inside ten minutes; a drift it fixed itself is not news and prints nothing. What reaches the person is the sentence it writes when the ceiling is hit, which names the channel and what to do. Everything else goes to stderr, which Hermes keeps only when the run fails.
name: moe-channel-holder
